verdict.rationale: Veo's docs say it turns text prompts into short videos, and the video docs say results can be refined across multiple turns through the Interactions API, including conversational edits like element replacement. The iteration piece rests on that single API-level docs page, which also carries a notice to migrate to Gemini Omni Flash. That leaves unclear whether multi-turn refinement belongs to Veo itself and how durable it is; community reports also note prompt-adherence misses. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of iterative refinement without regenerating from scratch, clear attribution of multi-turn editing to Veo rather than a successor model, and documentation of iteration in creator-facing tools like Flow or Gemini.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: It excels at quickly turning text prompts and images into short videos, and lets you refine results across multiple turns using the Interactions API.
multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement or perspective changes)
